worldcombat.skill.expandingforce.summary: Slam psychic force into the target's ground and leave a psychic terrain; cast it while standing on one and the wave detonates around you, hitting every adjacent foe for more.
worldcombat.skill.expandingforce.descrip: Spreads a psychic terrain of radius %1$s blocks at the impact point for %2$s s; grounded foes inside move heavily.
If the user is standing on a psychic terrain, it absorbs the field instead, detonating within %1$s blocks around itself at 1.5x power.
worldcombat.skill.expandingforce.timing: Windup %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.expandingforce.prefere: Only attack within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to spread terrain; when off it stays put.
With this many enemies gathered near the target, the cast is raised to a high-priority opening.
